financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales of 962,000 shares via Jefferies Sales Agreement, July 1 2023 to report date
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: From July 1, 2023 through the date of this report, the Company issued and sold an aggregate of 962,000 additional shares of common stock pursuant to its Company’s Sales Agreement with Jefferies for aggregate net proceeds of $5.1 million.

financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of 14,375,000 shares at $4.80, including full option exercise
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The closing of the offering took place on August 1, 2023.
